filters.emptyHint: Choose another category or clear the filter

telegramGroups.title: Notifications
telegramGroups.subtitle: Markets' Telegram groups: messages about new and cancelled orders go here
telegramGroups.listHint: A market can have separate groups for new and cancelled orders
telegramGroups.emptyHint: To connect a market's Telegram group, click «Add notification»

status.inactiveHint: The bot was removed from the group — reconnect it

delete.title: Are you sure you want to delete it?
delete.descriptionCreate: Messages about {{market}}'s new orders will no longer be sent to this group. You can reconnect the group later.
delete.descriptionCancel: Messages about {{market}}'s cancelled orders will no longer be sent to this group. You can reconnect the group later.

create.title: Add notification
create.introTitle: Connect notifications to a Telegram group
create.intro: Choose the market and the message type, then open the one-time link — the bot joins the group and connects it by itself.
create.typeHint: A market can have separate groups for new and cancelled orders.
create.qrAlt: QR code of the Telegram group connection link
create.step1: Open the link or scan the QR code with your phone.
create.step2: Choose the group — the bot joins it.
create.step3: The bot connects the group by itself, the list refreshes.
create.waiting: Waiting for the group to connect…
create.expiredHint: The link is valid for 10 minutes and works once. Get a new one.
create.command: Add the bot to the group and send this command there:
create.existsTitle: A group of this type is already connected
create.exists: {{market}} already has a group of this type (ID: {{groupId}}). The bot does not replace it — edit it in the list, or delete it and connect again.

editDialog.title: Edit notification
editDialog.groupIdHint: For example: -1001234567890. Send /id in the group and the bot shows its ID.

dispatch.pageDescription: Notification to users of the system
dispatch.customerDisabled: Customers cannot be messaged from here — the system does not find them by role (0 recipients).
dispatch.allHint: The message goes to every employee and market in the system.
dispatch.inAppAlways: Always on — the message is kept in the inbox
dispatch.telegramHint: With a market chosen — to that market's Telegram group; without one — to each recipient's personal Telegram (recipients who have not connected are skipped).
dispatch.title: Title
dispatch.groupKeyHint: Re-sending with this key creates no duplicate — the existing message is updated.
dispatch.confirmIrreversible: A sent message cannot be recalled.
dispatch.confirmBroadcast: WARNING: the message goes to ALL users. This cannot be undone.
dispatch.unknownOutcome: The server did not answer in time. The message may still have been sent — it is not re-sent automatically. Check Notifications first; if needed, send again via "New message".
dispatch.smsHint: SMS costs money and goes only to recipients with a phone. If there are more recipients than the SMS limit, the server refuses to send.

push.enabled: Notifications are on — new messages will arrive on this device.
push.disabled: Notifications are off — they will no longer arrive on any device of your account.
push.enableFailed: Could not turn on notifications. Please try again later.
push.disableFailed: Could not turn off notifications. Please try again.
push.blocked: Notifications are blocked in your browser. To turn them on, allow them for this site in the browser settings.
push.explainBody: When a new order or an important event happens, your phone (or computer) gets a notification — even when the app is closed. Next, the browser will ask for permission: tap “Allow”.
